notes: «أخبرنا شعبة، وحدثنا حبيب ... حدثنا زيد بن وهب» : the four names are read as co-transmitters of one level; whether شعبة is a separate route is not settled by the text, so this is a best reading
the rest is Bukhari's comment (the Companion Abu al-Darda is named only in the comment, not in the chain)
